paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how translation quality (BLEU) varies with latency measured by Average Lagging (AL) for four training/testing consistency conditions on the IWSLT14 De dataset. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)”, uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 2 to 11 with regularly spaced tick labels at 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 26 to 34 with tick marks at integer intervals (26, 27, …, 34). The “Consistency-CE” series is a light purple dashed line with circular markers that increases across AL, from about 26.2 at AL≈2 to about 31.4 at AL≈11, passing through approximately 28.8 (AL≈4), 30.3 (AL≈6), and 31.1 (AL≈8). The “Inconsistency-CE” series is a darker purple dashed line with square markers that also increases with AL, from about 26.3 at AL≈2 to about 31.4–31.5 at AL≈11, with intermediate points near 28.9 (AL≈4), 30.3 (AL≈6), and 31.1 (AL≈8). The “Inconsistency-CE-MP” series is a blue dashed line with square markers that rises from about 26.8 at AL≈2 to about 32.2 at AL≈11, with points around 29.3 (AL≈4), 31.0 (AL≈6), and 31.8 (AL≈8). The “Consistency-Bi” series is a red solid line with star markers, shown only for higher AL values (starting around AL≈4), increasing from about 30.4 at AL≈4 to about 33.0 at AL≈11, with intermediate star-marked values near 30.9 (AL just under 5), 32.3 (AL≈7.5), and 32.7 (AL≈8.5).
